scope.input: diff, stated criteria, standing operating contract

findings.property: Later charges attach to selected retained rubble at its current location
findings.problem: Ground-level roof rubble rejects a new charge even though the inventory is empty and the exact visible body is selected.
findings.cause: Charge placement first requires proximity to the original storey volume; the selected current body is consulted only after that filter. Upper-storey bodies on the ground fail the seven-metre vertical-distance limit.
findings.reproduction: Run node /tmp/astra-round4-verification/probe.mjs; inspect roofRubble. Uses the same building, original-level, selected-body and current rendered-surface inputs as the native pointer handler.
findings.recommendation: Resolve selected bank bodies before the original-storey proximity filter and preserve the correct floor association for detonation. Add an upper-storey-to-ground regression case.

criteriaEvidence.proceduralOfflineBankConstruction: Diff uses existing locally vendored Three.js and procedural retained bodies; no dependency added.
criteriaEvidence.intactCourtGalleriesRoof: Suite passes court void, construction-role presence, slab-area and pristine no-drift checks; visual acceptance belongs to separate native QA.
criteriaEvidence.localizedAndExtensiveDestruction: Suite passes local-wound, isolated bay failure and six-normal-charge substantial-collapse cases.
criteriaEvidence.actualAttachments: Suite passes localized roof attachment loss and attachment-driven exact replay.
criteriaEvidence.retainedRubbleAndSupport: Suite passes finite grounded persistent bodies, support wake-up and no repeated tonnage awards.
criteriaEvidence.snapshotsReplayBranchMinuteRebuild: Suite passes exact snapshots, branching, full rolling minute and pristine restore after eviction.
criteriaEvidence.existingScoreQualityBallDistrict: Suite passes scoring, quality independence, ball solid contact, neighboring-building transfer and district replay; independent probe adds bank-specific quality parity.

limitations: No second browser campaign was started; native pointer/UI proof remains with the parent task.
Headless fixture excludes the canvas-rendered bank inscription.
Stylized collision/support approximations were assessed for criterion violations, not engineering structural accuracy.
